scope: ERP PLANEX popup shell; first reviewed on /erpv2/company/feo/requests/transfers
acceptance: OWNER explicitly accepted title and cross, then footer; on 2026-10-24 reconfirmed that the sandbox title decision is canon.

approved.title: IBM Plex Sans 19px / 700 / 22px, letter-spacing -0.035em, color #131210, matching the registry Page Header title. The close control remains at the right corner of the header.
approved.footer: Min-height 48px; background #F0EDE6, same as the shown header; top divider #DEDAD0; horizontal padding 16px. Existing-object deletion occupies a separate calm left area only when real deletion exists. Cancel and one main action form the right group; buttons may wrap on narrow widths without reducing the font. A red danger button is reserved for a separate destructive confirmation.
